text:
marta: quick heads-up — PR #4823 is ready for final merge but touches auth plumbing for on-prem deployments. Adds service account key handling + a small KMS integration. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4823

kai: thanks. can you summarize the security scope? i skimmed diffs but want a TL;DR for reviewers.

marta: sure — changes: 1) new secrets loader that reads from customer HSM/KMS or local vault depending on env; 2) migrate older env var usage to secrets.ref; 3) add an endpoint to rotate service account keys (internal only). No user-facing changes.

samir: left 3 inline comments about header validation and one about missing tests for the rotation endpoint. small stuff.

olivia: tagging me. i'll do the KMS/HSM design review later today. quick question: does the on-prem package bundle a KMS stub or rely entirely on customer HSM?

marta: on-prem ships a thin shim (kms-stub) that proxies to whatever the customer's HSM or KMS connector is. default behavior is no-op if not configured so tests add a fake key.

security-bot: automated secret-scan: test/fixtures/keys/fake_key.pem appears to contain private key material. flagged in PR #4823.

marta: ack. that's intended for unit tests but i'll rotate it to an ephemeral generated key in the test harness. planned change before merge.

olivia: two high-level asks: (1) ensure keys at rest are wrapped with customer KMS root (if available), (2) add audit events for rotate/issue ops. can you add an event schema?

marta: yes, will add audit events and update the docs. event schema suggestion: `event_type: auth.key.rotate`, `actor`, `target_customer_id`, `method: kms|hsm|stub` — i'll add to the PR description.

kai: any blockers from infra side (network, ports) for on-prem?

marta: no new ports. shim runs on localhost by default and connects to customer HSM via whatever transport they expose. i'll document the network expectations in onprem/README.

samir: once tests updated and the flagged fixture removed i'm fine approving. can you squash the small lint fixes into one commit?

marta: yep — i'll push one more commit later today. target merge window tomorrow morning 09:30 PT if security sign-off arrives.

olivia: i can approve after i confirm the wrapping + audit events. should be able to finish by EOD.

deploy-bot: scheduled merge window request received for 2026-02-17 09:30 PT. awaiting required approvals: security, eng-owner.

marta: putting a checklist in the PR: - remove test fixture private key - add audit events - document onprem network + kms setup - squash commits

kai: pinging @olivia and @samir for approvals when ready. thanks! :thumbsup:

samir: noted. i'll re-run the unit suite after your update and give final thumbs up.

marta: thanks everyone — will update PR and ping back here. :pray:
